data.title: 洛茜 · 公园里把好喝的汽水分你
data.description: 周末公园长凳上，洛茜穿莓红拉链卫衣与百褶裙，把刚拧开的另一瓶汽水递向你。她歪头露出爽朗笑容，自己的饮料放在身旁，空位上没有杂物；树影轻轻落在奶油白帆布鞋上。
data.action: 坐在长凳一侧，递出新开的汽水瓶
data.mood: 爽朗的分享和邀你坐近
data.promptProse: Rossy sits on a park bench in her berry-red hoodie and charcoal pleated skirt, tilting her head as she offers a freshly opened soda bottle. Her own drink stands beside her and the neighboring seat stays clear. The eye-level cowboy view includes the bench slats and shaded path behind. Dappled daylight catches the bottle shoulder and cream sneakers, laying gentle leaf shadows over her opaque tights.
